test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following conclusions can be drawn on the basis of the given statements?

**Statement 1:** All tigers are humans.

**Statement 2:** No human is an animal.
solution:
• The Venn diagram of the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6ad9ac5f6635cd45d8d25a6a37fc869fa9d3a5e0db998c45b534b5292f1e51b.png] 

**Conclusions:**

 
• All tigers are animals → False (This is not possible because all tigers are humans which are not animals.)
 
• Some tigers are animals → False (This is not possible because all tigers are humans which are not animals.)
 
• Some humans are tigers → True (As shown in the Venn diagram, a part of humans is tiger.)
 
• Some animals are humans → False → (This is not possible because no human is an animal)​​

 
• Thus, only the conclusion given in option 3 follows from the given statements.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
